title: Cerebras stock hits post-IPO low, tumbling 20% for the week on Nvidia pressure and lockup expiration
source_used: none for CNBC; The Tech Buzz (rewrite of CNBC, low quality, not relied on) and Benzinga via AOL (30 Sep) read as related coverage
key_facts: Headline facts (CNBC, 2 Oct 2026): Cerebras stock hit a post-IPO low and fell 20% for the week on Nvidia pressure and lockup expiration.
Related coverage (Benzinga via AOL, 30 Sep 2026): Cerebras's IPO lockup releases shares in 11 waves rather than all at once; a 19.4 million-share release hit on Wed 30 Sep.

Related coverage (Benzinga): two more larger releases fall on 14 Oct and 28 Oct; the whole schedule ends no later than 9 Nov 2026 (180 days after the IPO prospectus date, two trading days after third-quarter earnings).

Related coverage (Benzinga): shares were trading below the $185 IPO price, at $183.85 (down 5.76%) on 30 Sep; reports said OpenAI's new Ultrafast model tier runs on Nvidia GPUs rather than Cerebras (not confirmed by either company).
why_it_matters_hint: A newly listed AI chip company is under pressure from Nvidia while early holders gain the right to sell.
notes: CNBC returns HTTP 403 (error page). The Tech Buzz piece repeats CNBC's headline facts but adds generic, partly dated background (it names H100/Blackwell as Nvidia's current chips), so it was not used for facts. Benzinga/AOL piece is from 30 Sep (earlier event, lockup schedule only).
